en: A black and white image showing a bustling riverside market with many people, boats docked along the river, and a large suspension bridge crossing over the water. Atop a hill in the background, there is a grand palace-like building dominating the skyline, along with several spires and historical architecture. The bridge is a striking architectural landmark with tall towers. The market scene is lively, with many people in 19th century style dress.
